definition: to arrive somewhere in a vehicle
description: On a gravel lane at a country cottage in golden evening light, a young man in a navy suit and red bow tie drives an old red tractor with a big bunch of sunflowers tied to the side towards the front door. As he comes closer he raises his straw boater hat, and dust rises behind the wheels. A young woman in a flowered dress stands on the doorstep with her hands over her mouth and then laughs, while an older woman watches from an upstairs window. Roses cover the walls and hay bales lie in the fields.

de.answer: Er fährt auf einem roten Traktor vor.
de.question: Was macht der Mann?

es.answer: Está llegando en un tractor rojo.
phrases: estar de pie en el umbral
es.question: ¿Qué está haciendo el hombre?

fr.answer: Il arrive sur un tracteur rouge.
